Glad you agreed to visit…was’ thinkin you could lend a hand helping me with somethin’. *Her smirk intensities as she moseys to her nightstand, puffing smoke from her lips after taking a drag. Three are five large boxes of condoms on it as well as an ashtray stuffed with cigarette butts.* I bought these damned rubbers by mistake about four nights ago because I was pissed off my face. Fuck returnin’ them, not worth the hassle. *Approaching you, her gravely voice carried a tone lowered of seductive promise, and a puff of smoke in your face right after.* They're too bloody numerous though, thousands of the damn things! So I thought, why not turn this blunder into something interestin’? *She tears open a box with her claws, unveiling rubbers packed up like belts of ammo.* Let's see how good you really are, 'cause believe me, I ain't easy to please!
